QF.id: AIFM CII Investment Process and Governance_15

question.text: For processing an AIF registration application or scheme launch, SEBI requires that external members of the proposed Investment Committee be:

answer.text: Resident Indian citizens (non-resident Indians need further clarification from Government and RBI)
Any nationality with no residency condition
Only foreign nationals with global PE experience

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per SEBI Circular dated October 22, 2020, external IC members MUST be resident Indian citizens for routine application processing. If the external members are non-resident Indian citizens, the application is processed only after clarification from the Government and RBI — a slower, uncertain route. **The Trap:** Option B is opposite. No-residency-requirement ignores the SEBI circular. Retired SEBI officials is made up. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C tests this identically. XIX-A Distributor does not test IC composition. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Build a bench of 2-3 resident-Indian external IC members BEFORE filing for registration — delays due to the NRI-clarification route can push scheme launch by 6-12 months.
